signature.name: VTask.changeOriginSeriesTerm
signature.type: {𝕜 : Type u_1} -> {E : Type u_2} -> {F : Type u_3} -> [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] -> [NormedAddCommGroup E] -> [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] -> [NormedAddCommGroup F] -> [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] -> (p : FormalMultilinearSeries 𝕜 E F) -> (k l : ℕ) -> (s : Finset (Fin (k + l))) -> (hs : s.card = l) -> E [×l]→L[𝕜] E [×k]→L[𝕜] F

conventions.statement: For any valid s with s.card = l, ‖VTask.changeOriginSeriesTerm p k l s hs‖ = ‖p (k + l)‖, so the norm depends only on k and l, not on the choice of subset s.
If p (k + l) = 0 (e.g. p is a polynomial of degree less than k + l), then VTask.changeOriginSeriesTerm p k l s hs = 0 as a continuous multilinear map.

facts.statement: ∀ {𝕜 : Type*} {E : Type*} {F : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] (p : FormalMultilinearSeries 𝕜 E F) (k l : ℕ) (s : Finset (Fin (k + l))) (hs : s.card = l), ‖VTask.changeOriginSeriesTerm p k l s hs‖ = ‖p (k + l)‖

facts.statement: ∀ {𝕜 : Type*} {E : Type*} {F : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] (p : FormalMultilinearSeries 𝕜 E F) (k l : ℕ) (s : Finset (Fin (k + l))) (hs : s.card = l) (x y : E), VTask.changeOriginSeriesTerm p k l s hs (fun _ => x) (fun _ => y) = p (k + l) (s.piecewise (fun _ => x) (fun _ => y))

facts.statement: ∀ {𝕜 : Type*} {E : Type*} {F : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace 𝕜 F] (p : FormalMultilinearSeries 𝕜 E F) (k l : ℕ) (s : Finset (Fin (k + l))) (hs : s.card = l) (x y : E), ‖VTask.changeOriginSeriesTerm p k l s hs (fun _ => x) (fun _ => y)‖₊ ≤ ‖p (k + l)‖₊ * ‖x‖₊ ^ l * ‖y‖₊ ^ k
